name: HMScan Viewer
summary:
HMScan Viewer is a quick, free way to look at 3D models on your Meta Quest.

Choose a folder once and your models appear in a simple gallery with thumbnails. Pick one and it appears in your room, ready to grab, turn and scale. Switch to Clay to study the shape, or turn the room dark to focus on the model.

- Opens GLB, OBJ, PLY and STL files
- Shows colour and textures
- Works in your room or in a dark space
- Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed

Files stay on your headset. You must be 18 or older
